title: Build TUI dashboard from operator projection
purpose: Create the primary AgentOS dashboard view from existing OperatorProjection and support bundle state.
scope: Render runtime health, degraded mode and local-only baseline state.
Render recent runs and pending approval counts.
Render audit, update, adapter, ecosystem and safety summaries.
Render support bundle readiness and last export state.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard view is derived from projection data, not duplicated runtime queries.
Dashboard explains missing optional dependencies without blocking baseline TUI.
Dashboard shows whether TUI is durable, demo or headless projection mode.
Raw secrets are not present in rendered output.
failure_modes: Dashboard hides degraded or rollback-pending state.
Dashboard introduces a second source of runtime truth.
